meter.subtitle: Automatic combat capture
meter.empty: No recognized player damage in this capture yet.
meter.about: Names and summon owners come from observed packets; unknown identities keep their IDs. Skill labels use optional local saved reports. Average DPS uses the encounter duration.
meter.encounterEnded: Encounter ended; the next hit starts a new fight.
meter.resetArchives: Reset archives the current fight and starts a new one.
meter.retained: Up to 10 fights are retained in memory. Open and save recordings to keep them.
meter.identity: {{names}} observed names · {{members}} roster members · {{labels}} cached skill labels. Capture runs from app launch; open the app before zoning or forming your party so identity and spawn packets are observed.
meter.integrity: {{gaps}} stream gaps · {{dropped}} driver drops · {{rejected}} rejected combat frames · {{desyncs}} resyncs
meter.rules: Explicit summon owners are credited; ambiguous owners are not inferred. Healing-family attacks require a confirmed monster target. Other unknown skills are excluded. A fight ends once every engaged target is confirmed defeated, otherwise after the idle timeout following the last counted damage dealt. A confirmed boss death stops the fight clock; the fight closes 15 s later unless a new phase begins.
